author: CLOUD
trigger: Direct owner request: consider Albania and northern Italy, recommend complementary markets for MIRA assortment

result.scope: Six market-level screens with dated evidence and exact supplier seeds for Albania/Milan/Garda; no new project import dataset or commercial admission

findings.finding: Albania April 2026 accommodation visitors increased 19.7% y/y, non-residents 22.6%. BALFIN corporate sources provide Green Coast and Vlora Marina supplier seeds within the same group, not two independent developers.
findings.limitations: National accommodation demand is not unit occupancy, yield or property-price growth. April is a dated observation, not claimed latest month. Exact title, concession/lease, permits, inventory, seller, commission and media rights remain unverified. Country is not described as an EU member.

findings.finding: Northern Italy should be split into Garda own-use/second-home, Milan urban and a selective Como premium category. AbitareIn has four named Milan catalogue projects; Garda Haus describes an agency/international-client route rather than developer status.
findings.limitations: Category positioning is CLOUD recommendation. AbitareIn includes Ready to Live refurbishment, so not all entries are new construction. Catalogue presence is not inventory/mandate. MAECI general reciprocity guidance does not establish a current case-specific Russian/Belarus buyer or bank approval. No automatic residence right inferred.

findings.finding: TUIK records 21,534 housing sales to foreigners in 2025, including 3,649 to Russian citizens; foreign sales declined 9.4% y/y. This supports testing Russian-language buyer relevance without claiming a booming foreign market.
findings.limitations: Full-year 2025, not current-month demand or MIRA conversions. Article is a primary indexed extract; direct page requires JavaScript. Property title, technical condition, actual transaction rights and channel eligibility remain separate.

findings.finding: Galt & Taggart's 2025 review/2026 outlook identifies unsold-stock/absorption pressure and yield compression in Batumi. Recommendation is Tbilisi urban and selective Batumi, not a bulk aparthotel assortment.
findings.limitations: Original analyst assessment, not official national statistics or a verified project yield. No advertised guaranteed return imported. Buyer demand for MIRA not yet tested.

findings.finding: CBC's 23 June 2026 Q1 release links residential-price growth to strong demand mainly from foreign buyers. Official Ministry procedure identifies non-EU property-acquisition permission. Suggested separate Republic of Cyprus collection: Paphos/Larnaca, selective Limassol.
findings.limitations: Not a case-specific legal/banking clearance, current inventory or future-return forecast. Do not mix northern-island offerings with Republic of Cyprus legal descriptions. Government procedure read as indexed primary text; later direct open returned an internal error.

findings.finding: Bank of Greece provisional Q1 2026 nominal apartment price change: +5.7% national and +6.4% Thessaloniki. Suggested later research is Thessaloniki/Chalkidiki and selected Crete, not a Golden Visa offer.
findings.limitations: Apartment-price index is not a villa return, future appreciation or residence entitlement. Current buyer/site/legal/payment permissions unverified.

decisions.authority: OWNER nominated Albania and northern Italy; CLOUD selected screening structure under existing research delegation
decisions.decision: Treat Albania coastal property and northern Italy own-use/urban property as distinct research assortments. Recommend Turkey, Georgia and Republic of Cyprus as complementary next candidates; Greece later.
decisions.reason: Diversify buyer use cases rather than adding interchangeable country flags; assess real supplier and transaction paths, not only tourism or price momentum.
decisions.implementationStatus: Market screening and source note committed; project collections, supplier mandates, CRM imports and publication NOT performed

decisions.decision: Next concrete research outputs: X02 Albania 3-5 exact project candidates across at least two independently evidenced supplier groups if available; X03 northern Italy 3-5 exact project/offer candidates separated Garda/Milan and any validated Como path; X04 later one concrete supplier/transaction path per Turkey/Georgia/Republic of Cyprus.
decisions.reason: Small verifiable pilot assortments instead of large unqualified listings; account for Italy developer versus local-agency mandates and refurbishment/secondary distinctions.
decisions.implementationStatus: Scope written only; no new automation, new LOCAL execution task or externally sent request
